newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks seen weak on Brazil, US markets.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks seen weak on Brazil, US markets.

text.p: Argentine blue chips were seen opening lower again Monday, with continuing concerns about Brazilian volatility compounded by losses in U.S. Treasuries, dealers said.

"The market should open lower again because of turbulence from Brazil," said Miguel Daneri of Boston Securities. "And now they have found a new excuse to shave prices in the rise in the U.S. 30-year Treasury yield to around 6.55 percent."
The MerVal blue-chip index, which closed 1.62 percent weaker Friday at 802.11 points with cumulative losses of 5.70 percent for the week, was seen finding support at 760/780.
Dealers expect the underlying buying interest to return at those levels and re-route the market to its recent good gains.
"The market's fundamental trend is still positive. These losses are simply a short-term correction," said one dealer. "Prices should recover towards the weekend."
